modules.title: Cryptography: From Caesar Ciphers to Quantum Keys
modules.description: Journey through the history and mathematics of secret communication, from ancient substitution ciphers to modern encryption and post-quantum cryptography.

modules.title: The Fall of Rome: Empire in Decline
modules.description: Explore the political, economic, and military forces that brought down one of history's greatest empires, from the Crisis of the Third Century to the final collapse of the Western Roman Empire.

modules.title: Introduction to Logic
modules.description: A foundational module covering basic logical reasoning, including deductive reasoning, common fallacies, and argument analysis.

modules.title: From Newton to Einstein: The Scientific Revolution
modules.description: Trace the evolution of physics from classical mechanics through electromagnetism to the revolutionary ideas of relativity and quantum mechanics.
